Following today's 'Surprise and Shine' event, Apple has updated its official Design Resources website to add new product bezel assets for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro. Details below.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro bezel assets now available

Designers should be no strangers to the Apple Design Resources website — this platform offers a variety of hardware and software assets for use in their own work.

These include Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG, and SVG assets for Apple platforms, products, and technologies, along with fonts, SF Symbols, Apple's Icon Composer, as well as badges and logos for services such as Apple Health and Apple Wallet.

After announcing the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro today, Apple has updated the Design Resources website to add Photoshop and PNG assets for these two new devices.

The assets include images of the iPhone Duo in both its unfolded and closed forms across two color options, as well as various models of the iPhone 18 Pro featuring a smaller Dynamic Island.

To check out these new bezel assets, along with other existing assets on the Apple Design Resources website, click this link.
